title: •See-Threepio
caption: •See-Threepio (V)
game_text: Unless Jabba on table: you must first use 3 Force to play How Did We Get Into This Mess?; and, once per turn, if with R2-D2 at a Jabba’s Palace site, may place your hand in Used Pile to draw the same number of cards from Reserve Deck.
lore: C-3PO was Jabba’s “khan chita,” or translator. Survived more battles than most members of the Alliance. Wasn’t informed of R2-D2’s role in the rescue of Han.
copyright: © LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 1999 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Droid: two stat boxes, POWER 1 and the wide PROTOCOL DROID label box; deploy 2 / forfeit 5 (printed 3/4). Icon column empty. Curly apostrophe in Jabba’s. Slip text matches the stub. BASE PAGE: the stub's 'Decipher base: [[See-Threepio]]' link redirects to the Premiere 'C-3PO (See-Threepio)' (wiki error) — the printed card is the Enhanced Jabba's Palace premium 'See-Threepio' (page 'See-Threepio (Enhanced Jabba's Palace)'), matching the slip's title and Jabba's Palace text. Droid (gold droid disc). Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes “khan chita,” (wiki has straight single quotes) and curly apostrophes in Jabba’s, Wasn’t, R2-D2’s. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright SE-style form with 1999, legible on the zoomed scan. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 350 px).
